limitations: Actual WebGL static observer evidence; not new flight proofs, hardware performance or human art acceptance.
Every image comparison retains hashes/counts, not raw pixel buffers.
Existing facade batches keep their quality thresholds. Expanded bounds may change frustum culling; no universal per-frame draw-count parity is claimed.
Coast and Campus are actual procedural fallback scenes, with no built-in GLB; Courtyard control explicitly loads its built-in GLB.

Courtyard control preloads existing encoded textures and material dependencies in GLTF source order equally on both sides, preserving production material content and draw policy. Temporary loader hooks restore immediately after import. Uncontrolled asynchronous-image-order failures are retained separately; this constrained comparison is not a claim of unconstrained Courtyard raster determinism.
